en.title: Northern Jiangsu Yellow Sea Wetlands: Where to Stay and Visit
en.headline: Northern Jiangsu’s Yellow Sea Wetlands: Choose a Responsible Visitor Base
en.description: Separate Yancheng's dispersed wetland areas, choose Dongtai, Dafeng or the city as a practical base, and plan ethical birding with a no-sighting alternative.
